primary_risk: Dependence on a few key customers
sector_survival_note: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive and subject to rapid technological change, which may lead to disruption of market leaders.
thesis_summary: Lattice Semiconductor provides FPGA-based semiconductor technology that enables the development of high-performance, low-power electronics, riding the trend of increasing demand for AI and IoT devices.
thesis_breaks_if: Short-term news cycles or 8-K items that structurally change the company's business model or competitive advantage.
sentiment_note: Richly valued, but a great company with a strong moat and durable business model.
ten_k_highlights: The company's revenue has been rising at a CAGR of 38.2% over the past 5 years.
The company's gross margin has been stable at around 68% over the past 5 years.
The company's ROIC has been falling at a rate of 91.0% over the past 5 years.
valuation_note: FCF yield 0.7%, PEG 0.6, EV/EBITDA 266, P/S 33 — very richly valued — starter position only.
implied_growth_note: The price assumes near-perfect execution for a decade — start small.
priced_for_perfection_note: Price already assumes ~34%/yr growth for a decade — start small, add on weakness
